data.narrative:
Beyond Aero is a Series A transportation company founded by Eloa Guillotin, Hugo Tarl\u00e9, and Valentin Chomel, having raised $44M to date. The broader Transportation sector comp universe includes 6 private peers (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, FleetZero, REGENT Craft) and no direct public comparables; however, the lack of same-stage or adjacent-stage transportation companies with sufficient data density prevents reliable peer-median triangulation.

Stage-progression methodology proves applicable as the sole quantitative anchor. Using total raised ($44M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage advancement yields $88M. This method rests on the assumption that downstream funding steps historically reflect this magnitude of step-up within frontier-tech transportation, though idiosyncratic company performance and market conditions will create variance around this baseline.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $75M (low) to $101M (high), with $88M as the median point. Given reliance on a single methodological anchor and absence of peer-comparable data, the key uncertainties remain: (1) whether Beyond Aero's technical progress and market traction warrant step-up multiples consistent with historical Transportation-stage patterns, and (2) whether frontier-tech transportation continues to command the fundraising discipline reflected in this dataset. This range should be stress-tested against specific metrics of technical progress and go-to-market execution.
